description:
Photo library and raw development; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Lightroom, rebuilt in pure Rust

Photo library and raw development; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Lightroom, rebuilt in pure Rust.
Your photos. Your pixels. Your machine. Native on macOS, Windows and Linux. In the browser via WebAssembly. Drivable end to end by AI agents over MCP.
LightCraft is a complete darkroom in a single native app. Every adjustment is non-destructive, so your originals are never touched. Every slider renders through a scene-referred, wide-gamut, 32-bit float pipeline: highlights roll off like film, shadows open up without halos, and colour stays clean from capture to export.
Pure Rust, no C. Our own RAW decoders (DNG, Canon CR2, Sony ARW, Nikon NEF, Fujifilm RAF incl. X-Trans, Panasonic RW2, Pentax PEF, Olympus ORF), our own colour science, our own pipeline. JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, PSD composites and JPEG XL open today.
What's Changed
- Integration batch 46 (6 community PRs) by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3584
- Fix Histogram::percentile returning black when the target truncates to 0 by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3515
- GPU equivalence tests run on a software adapter when asked (lavapipe, WARP), for local runs on every platform by @THEtheChad in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3370
- Reject shutter fractions with a non-positive numerator or denominator by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3442
- Match library search date: token case-insensitively by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3445
- Reject overflowing LIGHTCRAFT_GPU_LIMITS values instead of panicking by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3465
- LR-VIEW-SURVEY: ⌘/Ctrl-click on a survey tile takes the photo out of the survey by @Yeetjof in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3563
- Keep unequal margins when merging full settings with linkMargins on by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3443
